crossBureau.title: Bureau Coordination
crossBureau.ownershipNotice: Coordination shares only explicitly permitted information. The primary handling Bureau retains complaint ownership and the existing disposal process.
crossBureau.empty: No coordination records in your authorized scope.
crossBureau.noDisclosure: Origin approval and target acceptance are required before contributing officers can access the shared workspace. Supporting evidence can be shared explicitly after activation.
crossBureau.frozen: Coordination is read-only because the primary complaint is disposed or its handling Bureau/assignment changed. Review the case through the existing authorized workflow before initiating new coordination.
crossBureau.responsibilities: Officers work on their assigned tasks. Receiving Bureau Heads supervise their own Bureau; the lead Bureau reviews findings and completion.
crossBureau.documentPolicy: Evidence is not shared automatically. Select participating Bureaus explicitly. Accepted formats: PDF, PNG, JPEG and DOCX, up to 10 MB. Downloads recheck current membership and sharing permissions.
crossBureau.sharingScope: Explicit sharing scope (the lead Bureau retains access)
crossBureau.existingDocument: Existing complaint document ID (requires existing case access)
crossBureau.noticeMessage: A coordination record requires your attention.
crossBureau.reminderSoon: A coordination task is approaching its requested date.
